deep_analysis:
We are on the RIGHT side of the market and STILL bleeding. That is the whole story this cycle.

Positions: 4 open, all LONG, +0.08 unrealized — regime-aligned (btc_15m LONG_BIAS, btc_4h LONG_BIAS, continuum ABOVE, BTC above EMA300 for 1,288 consecutive ticks, trend_quality STRONG_UP). No open trade is up 2%+ or open 8h+, so no breakeven/trail/stale steers are due yet. Directional alignment is NOT the problem.

Selection is the problem. Last 24h: 36 closed, 14W/21L, 39% WR, -0.74 USDT. 9 of the 21 losses ended in hard_max_loss or trail_arm_timeout — they never reached the +0.40% trail arm, meaning they went straight down from entry (STX -4.9%, PUMP -5.9%, COMP -5.7%, XPL -3.5%, INJ -3.7%/-3.4%). These are not wrong-direction trades in a bear; they are LONGs placed in coins that had NO trend of their own while the market trended. The winning side in each case was simply: no trade, or wait until the coin itself shows trend (like continuum-trend+ did — 85.7% WR, and 13 of 14 winners today exited via profit-monster-trail, i.e. the trail family).

Worst single position: BANANA long (0.6h). Coin tracker has BANANA trend=BEAR 60.8 with the weakest momentum of the book (42.9) while BTC trends up. It is the only open trade fighting its own tape — if it does not arm the trail (+0.4%) soon, it becomes the next hard_max_loss. SOL is fine (mom 75.8, BULL, +0.53%) but its stop sits only 0.30% below entry — tightest risk in the book; NEO and BTC are quiet and thesis-intact (meta_rsi 52.6 / 55.7, center of band).

Opportunity cost: 6 slots, 4 used, and the capital is sitting in two flat chop trades (BANANA, NEO at +0.07%) while top-momentum coins (JUP, CRV, ZEN, IOTA, USELESS all mom 80+/BULL) run without us. PATTERN 1 — Chop entries, no trail arm (URGENT): 9/21 24h losses = hard_max_loss (6) + trail_arm_timeout (3), gross -0.78 of -1.54 total losses (51%). Coins: STX, INJ x2, PUMP, XPL, MET, CFX, BLUR, APT — none reached +0.40% before dying. WINNING SIDE: the trend riders (continuum-trend+ 85.7% WR; all 13 trail-exit winners). Why we weren't on it: signals fired LONG on coins with flat/fading local structure while BTC trended — beta longs without coin-level trend. n=9, this is the single largest loss bucket.

PATTERN 2 — Shorts are auto-loss in this regime: 5 of 5 shorts closed in 24h lost (-0.37 total: CFX, CRV, COMP, BTC x2); 7d SHORT 24.4% WR. pump-chain- family: 37 trades, 21.6% WR, -0.57. WINNING SIDE: LONG — BTC above EMA300 1,288 consecutive ticks. Why we weren't on it: pump-chain short probes firing against a confirmed uptrend. Current book already corrected this: 4/4 long.

PATTERN 3 — r2v2-long4 is dead: 4 trades, 0W, -0.27, including today's STX -4.9% (meta_rsi 57.6 — center band, so RSI is NOT the discriminator; coin selection is). Entry RSI across 24h winners (22-73) vs losers (44-71) overlaps almost completely — DRIFT-E confirmed: signal-time RSI does not separate winners from losses. The separator is exit path: trail family wins, hard_max_loss loses.

PATTERN 4 — Same-coin churn: INJ took two consecutive pump-chain+ LONG hard_max_loss in one day (-0.08 each, RSI 50.0 and 55.3); SYRUP traded 4x (2W/2L, net +0.01 — pure fee churn). Re-entering the same losing coin/signal same-day is adding nothing.

For every loser: the winning side was either (a) the same direction but in a coin that actually trended (trail family), or (b) no trade at all (chop coins). Almost never the opposite direction — shorting here is fighting the tape.
